name: Hortobágy National Park - the Puszta
description: Hortobágy is a vast, flat expanse of grassland and wetland in eastern Hungary, the country's first national park and the largest semi-natural grassland in Europe. Herders have grazed animals here for thousands of years, and you can still spot T-shaped sweep wells, the long Nine-holed Bridge, and shimmering mirages over the plain. At night, part of it offers dark skies.
